# WO-210: SmartScreen step labels readable on /download/ (audit A13)
Status: open (GO in CLAUDE-042; worktree ready)
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Agent: web-builder
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: CP-46 / WO-204 audit A13 / CLAUDE-042

## Goal
Older readers must recognise "More info" and "Run anyway" on their own screen. The SmartScreen illustration labels on /download/ render at 17px; make them >=20px on that page only.

## Acceptance criteria
- Page-local override (`:global` into the SmartScreen spans) on /download/ only; labels >=20px at all widths, no overflow or clipping at 320px.
- `SmartScreen.astro` unchanged; keep `role=img`, alt text, release/fingerprint logic and every href.
- Keep line 1 `---`, every id, no inline styles/scripts.

## Allowed paths
- `web/src/pages/download/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_audit_download_followup.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
Same as WO-209 (full `tests/test_web*.py tests/codex/` must pass).
